reviews.text: I couldn't be happier with Best Care Animal Hospital Laura is wonderful I would highly recommend them
The dog had an fho surgery. Fantastic price, she’s healing well, and the staff are good people.
My husband and I have been bringing our dog here for years. TATO IS AMAZING AND WE LOVE HIM SO MUCH. He loves what he does and you’ll leave with a smile.
Thank you for ALL the stars!

After seeing three different vets for our dog’s allergies, Dr. Jimenez is the one who finally got it right. We’ve seen more progress in a short time with him than with all the previous vets combined. He actually gets to the root cause instead of just treating symptoms. We’ve found our forever vet. Highly recommend!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
Thank you for all the stars!!!

I took my little dog for a sedation groom and vet visit and I'm so glad I took her there instead of just a groomer. It turns out she has allergies and has to get the Citopoint shot every month and she also has an infection from all the licking and scratching. The groomer did a good job but my dog was smelly by the end of the day and I had to bathe her again. She's like a different dog now with the allergy and antibiotic shot, so much more calm and gentle and happy. She even lets me hold her hands now, she never let me touch them before. The staff was very thorough and all of them were very friendly. Thanks again everyone.
Rebecca has excellent customer service , stop by and visit her . 😉. Everyone are very friendly. …

Similar to other people leaving low ratings... We had a very similar experience at this clinic. We originally went in for a specific issue that needed attention, but instead of focusing on the reason for our visit, it felt like they were trying to push additional treatments and tests first. Throughout the appointment, we felt pressured into approving more expensive procedures before addressing the original concern we came in for.

We understand that some testing can be necessary, but the overall experience made us feel like the focus was more on increasing costs than providing practical and reasonable care. It was frustrating because we simply wanted treatment for the issue we brought our pet in for, yet the conversation kept shifting toward other recommended services and expenses.
For example we were convinced into getting some xrays done, and the time of picking up our dog no one went over the xrays or explained what else they made have seen.

We eventually sought a second opinion elsewhere, and the other veterinarian was able to address the problem directly without pushing unnecessary treatments or costly testing upfront. Unfortunately, after this experience, we no longer feel comfortable returning to this clinic.
Dr Jimenez and team took amazing care of our cat who sustained a serious bite from another animal.  Were able to be seen quickly.
Thank you for ALL the stars! We loved meeting yall and Pluto!

I can’t say enough great things about this clinic. The entire staff is amazing, and you can truly tell how much they care about the animals they treat. I brought my Doberman in for ear cropping, and they did a phenomenal job—everything came out exactly how I hoped.

What really stood out to me was the level of care after the procedure. They followed up, checked in, and made sure all of my questions were answered every step of the way. As a pet owner, that kind of attention and support means everything.

I have nothing but amazing things to say about them and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that genuinely cares. They truly are amazing.

My dog is extremely anxious and reactive and requires experienced handlers, and Best Care Animal always goes above and beyond to make sure he is treated with patience and compassion. The staff consistently provide excellent care, and I always feel confident leaving my dog in their hands. I truly appreciate the attention and professionalism they show every visit. I drive 30 minutes each way and have been for the past 5 years because that is how much I trust and value their services!
Best staff in the world
They take care of our 4 boys with lots of love! We love taking them there.
Lori and  Kyrstyn were amazing. Always greeted with a friendly smile and positive attitudes. They love the animals there like their own and don’t do the hidden fee bs. It’s always full transparency.
Thank you for ALLLLL the stars!

Best Care are incredibly helpful and go above and beyond to assist me. Everyone at the vet genuinely loves Tris, and we felt welcomed from the moment we walked in. They do a fantastic job looking after my dog and making both of us feel comfortable
Rude staff and unprofessional environment
Everyone here was wonderful & very kind , they took great care of my dog & the groomer is awesome!!!
Just nice all around every time we visit. Ella loves everyone
Thank you for ALL the stars!! Sweet Lola girl :)

Best Care Animal Hospital always takes good care of my baby! Mykayla did an AMAZING job on Bambi’s groom; she’s super soft and almost no shedding to be seen! Staff is always treating my baby like their own!
Dr Jimenez and his staff are super understanding and answered all my questions. 10 out of 10 if you want the best care for your pets!
I have a small chihuahua that is not very friendly, and the technician is so good with her for her pedicure. Excellent job and Matilda is good.  So patient.
Good staff great service treated my puppy with a lot of love very affordable  I recommend 100%
They are excellent. Saw my 13 year old Wheaten during the Holidays when she needed a referral for an MRI. Spent a good hour with us. Could not be more grateful to them.
Excelente servicio.. y personal ..Excellent service and very friendly staff.

Most loving, caring place you could  ever want to take your Furbaby. They are like family to us. THANK YOU ALL , SO MUCH❤️🐾

Took my kitty here for some health concerns and they took SUCH great care of him. Rebecca and Lori were extremely kind and helpful. We Ieft with all the answers we needed and medication to get my kitty feeling better. I will definitely be coming back!
A new puppy requires us owners to have a lot of information. The entire team was extremely knowledgeable, helpful and kind!  Thank you ladies for helping Finley and I get off to the right start.
Love these guys! Staff is great and they handle my babies with kindness and smiles!🥰

The two front desk girls were really nice and very attentive. They made me feel safe bringing my pets here, and I truly felt cared for. I know my babies are going to be well taken care of every time we come. Thank you for the great service!

A few days ago was my puppy Lena’s very first visit to Best Care Animal Hospital and it could not have gone any better!

From the moment we walked in, the staff was welcoming, kind and informative.  But the real highlight was Rebecca — Lena absolutely fell in love with her and the feeling was mutual.
Rebecca took the time to connect with Lena right away and their bond was instant.

It’s not every day you find someone who genuinely loves what they do and makes your pet feel so safe and cared for.

I left feeling confident that Lena is in great hands.  I highly recommend Best Care Animal Hospital and the amazing team there!
Highly recommend Best Care Animal Hospital! Friendly staff and excellent customer service!
Thank you for ALLL the stars!!!
This place is absolutely amazing and Jake enjoyed his visit and new treats
Thank you for ALLLLL the stars!!

They literally provided the Best Care for our girl.   She doesn’t even notice her stitches!  We had a very comforting experience and will return to this vet for future care.   Thank you Best Care, for taking care of our pup so well!
I have been coming here for over 10 years with my dog. Great staff!

Have taken my Yorkie to Best Care Animal Hospital twice. He has anxiety and trust issues with strangers. He has been to several groomers and Vets in Harris County for the last 4 years. None were able to groom him and labeled him aggressive. He was partially groomed at times and sent home w/o complete grooming but I was charged for entire services. With all this said.. My husband who cuts his own hair bought clippers did not know how to use them and ended up having to scissor cut which was not too appealing. I located Best Care Animal Hospital in Oct 2021 and was assured by staff member that my pet's needs could be met and he would be treated well. The first time my Yorkie was sedated because of anxiety, nervousness and of course the aggression. Services received were excellent. I was very satisfied with the services and the way he responded to me and the staff. The second time (last week) the Vet advised that sedation would be used if necessary. It was not needed and my Yorkie received full services with no problems. I could detect his calmness after entering. The staff are amazing, friendly and take time to speak with you about your concerns and to interact with your pet. The groomer is patient and works at gaining the pet's trust. I am so pleased and I know my Yorkie is as well!!
Thank you for ALLL the stars!!!
Thank you for ALLLLL the stars!
Great customer service!! Super friendly. The staff from the receptionist, tech, and vet were very nice and attentive.
Thank you for ALL the stars!
Eliana, Rebecca and Lori are great to deal with and were extremely curious and helpful.  They made the Vet visit a pleasant one.
Thank you!!!
Dr. Jimenez is knowledgeable and trustworthy.
Very friendly and professional

Excellent clinic, the care is very good. They are always willing to explain the procedures and why. It's clean, and the staff is very friendly and caring with pets. My cat and dog are loyal customers there. I recommend it 100 percent.
Thank you!!
I have taken both my pups here  and the have done so much for they are also more affordable  than most vets
The best place to take our pets, exceptional service, two 10 stars!

I had to put my 2 year old sweet baby boy cat to sleep yesterday may 5th and from the phone call to discuss options and get a second opinion from what Blue Pearl had told me (worst emergency clinic experience btw) until the time I left, everyone was extremely personable and accommodating. They helped me through the whole process as it was my first time with my own furbaby. They answered all my questions through my uncontrollable sobbing and was super patient and never rushed me and said I could take all the time I needed to say goodbye. I am wholeheartedly confident they will take care of my sweet boy, up until he is picked up Thursday to be cremated and I will be getting him back in 4-6 weeks depending on work load at the crematorium given they creamate one animal at a time. Also if you are having to euthanize and creamate or have the option to take your pet home to bury at home, they are very affordable, like less than $500(includes, consultation, euthanization, cremation with return of ashes and paw print). Even though this mama's heart is shattered, I can rest assure know my baby is safe and taken care of. THANK YOU TO ALL THE STAFF❤️🥰🥹
Thank you for the stars!!! We love Sky!!
Wonderful people. Excellent team. 100% recommended.

Dr Jimenez and staff have been wonderful to work with and take very good care of our dog Marley. Everyone here is very friendly and honest, the vet does not look to empty your pockets but works with you to find the best care and solution for your pets. The dr is very friendly and good with dogs. The front staff is really friendly too, we always feel welcome when we visit.
Excellent customer service, plus doggie care is outstanding! Reasonable prices!
Lori and her team are the best!  Dr J is amazing. He explains everything. They worked with our rescue and saved our Great Dane!  Highly recommend them!
Thank you all for the stars!

My dog is aggressive and anxious, and Best Care Animal Hospital has always been so patient and accommodating to my dog. They have always been reassuring. I drive an hour out to Best Care Animal hospital everytime for their services because that is how amazing they are! This is our third year going and they are always extremely sweet and understanding. THANK YOU BEST CARE! They truly live up to their name of providing the best care!

Best Care Animal Hospital has been an incredible vet to work with! The staff takes the time to understand your pet's concerns and history. Having a senior dog, this is super important! We travel for work, having the ability to order her medicine online has been a true blessing! Highly recommend!!
Awesome staff!

I’ve heard and witnessed the worst from this Vet. I’d advise everyone to look into options if you can. The owner doesn’t care about customer service from experience. Additionally it’s true. They have bad practices upselling, and no transparency.

My baby came there for treatment and diagnosis and was over tested due to just trying to charge us fees I feel like it’s all about the money and not about the care of the animals. If you are looking for somewhere that cares about your animals and not just a dollar that I would recommend you go somewhere else

BE AWARE… They don’t really care about you, your finances, and in some cases your dogs care. If you have trouble speaking up, and advocating for yourself you should stay away from this Vet. They practice upselling, and over my 5 visits I’ve been here so far my dog was neglected medicine for a week, I was charged for medication I “declined” the Dr that fills in only care about the money. The main dr/owner never reached out knowing the various of times his office failed us… Just be careful!! Don’t be fooled.

All of the staff I have interacted with were kind and compassionate, especially towards my dog. You can tell they love their jobs!
In my particular circumstances, front desk staff were attentive, available, and helpful. Thank you!

Hands down one of the best experiences so far. Staff are very friendly and so polite. Went out of their way to get our fur baby in quicker than my emergency appt. The lady behind the counter even offered and gave me a hug because she could see I needed one. They are treating our dog for a broken leg and I couldn’t imagine letting anyone else to give the kind of care they give you here. In addition, they are way more affordable!
Great service, they take the time to answer all our questions and they take very good care of our puppy, will highly recommend this place.

I have been a customer of this clinic for many years, taking my various pets in for examinations and treatments. It has always been a difficult negotiation regarding what tests I felt were necessary or I could afford. Instead of trying the obvious tests first; one that any good experienced Veterinarian would recommend, the Best Care Veterinarian Clinic provides you with a long quote recommending every test they can think of.  They prey on people's emotions to spend more money than medically necessary or that they can afford.  On my most recent visit I found the Veterinarian unreasonable and rude, he refused to treat my pet for an obvious skin issue unless I paid for an expensive test first.  I left and went to another Veterinarian Clinic right away and after examining my pet, the Vet prescribed the medication my pet needed.
They didn't try to force me to have unnecessary and expensive tests done.  I will no longer be taking my pets to Best Care and if asked I would discourage others to do so as well.
Thank you for ALLLL the stars!
Definitely recommend this place for all your pet needs! They groom my dogs very well and the customer service is awesome.
amazing place with wonderful staff
Thank you!!

Good service,  a little disappointed on there paperwork.  I aspects to have a report that happened.

But overall they are extremely nice and they know what they are doing

I appreciate Dr. Eduardo Jimenez and his entire team. I’ve taken both my dogs and cat here for routine care, acute care, and even surgery. They’ve always been so compassionate and helpful. I highly recommend them.
Always takes good care of my baby for his grooms and the front desk ladies are the best
